# Layrus Labs

> Layrus Labs (Layrus Labs Ltd) designs, builds and implements custom software
> systems, AI automation solutions, IoT and embedded systems for businesses with
> complex technical needs. Based in Abuja, Nigeria. Nine systems shipped
> across automotive, financial services, agriculture, healthcare, education,
> mobility, logistics and blockchain.

## What Layrus Does

Layrus Labs is a Nigerian engineering company operating across three
technical divisions:

### Software Systems
Custom business software, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, web applications,
REST and GraphQL APIs, backend systems, payment integrations, authentication
and authorisation systems, database architecture, cloud deployment, and
legacy system modernisation.

### AI & Automation
AI agents, WhatsApp AI sales assistants, Retrieval-Augmented Generation
(RAG) systems, AI document processing, knowledge bases, business workflow
automation, AI customer support systems, AI data extraction and
classification, and AI-powered analytics.

### Embedded & Connected Systems
PCB design, embedded systems engineering, IoT systems, firmware development,
hardware prototyping, sensor systems, custom microcontroller firmware,
device monitoring platforms, and hardware/software integration.

## Business Model

Layrus operates two models:

1. **Custom Engineering** — clients bring a technical problem; Layrus
   designs, builds and deploys the solution end to end.
2. **Layrus Products** — recurring problems are turned into reusable
   platforms and SaaS products.

## Engineering Process

Every project follows: Discovery → Technical Design → Implementation →
Handover → Managed Maintenance.

## Target Clients

- SMEs needing internal systems, automation, and customer platforms
- Startups needing MVPs, SaaS architecture and technical implementation
- Established companies needing modernisation, integrations, or AI tools
- Hardware/IoT companies needing PCB, firmware, cloud, and dashboards

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript
- **Backend:** Go, Rust, Python, Node.js
- **Data:** PostgreSQL, Redis, Object Storage
- **AI:** OpenAI, RAG, vector search, local models
- **Infrastructure:** Docker, Linux, CI/CD, Cloud/VPS
- **Hardware:** KiCad, C/C++, Rust, microcontrollers, IoT protocols

## Systems Built

- **RCareNG** (Software Platform) — Booking, roadside dispatch and full workshop management for an independent Mercedes-Benz specialist in Abuja. — layrus.com/projects/rcareng
- **Digital Tech Talent Hub** (Marketplace) — A two-sided marketplace where businesses hire verified tech freelancers, with client money held in escrow until delivery. — layrus.com/projects/digital-tech-talent-hub
- **videosynx** (AI & Media) — Give it a subject; it writes the code, runs it, explains it and renders a narrated tutorial video with captions. — layrus.com/projects/videosynx
- **AI Sales Employee** (AI Automation) — A WhatsApp sales assistant that quotes real prices from a shop's own catalogue, follows up, and takes payment. — layrus.com/projects/ai-sales-employee
- **WeGoComply** (Financial Services) — KYC, AML monitoring and regulatory reporting for Nigerian financial institutions. — layrus.com/projects/wegocomply
- **GanSys** (Agriculture & IoT) — Live farm telemetry and remote control for ESP32 sensors, actuators and pest-control schedules. — layrus.com/projects/gansys
- **CVD Expert** (Healthcare) — Cardiovascular risk prediction from 17 health parameters, trained on 300,000+ records. — layrus.com/projects/cvd-expert
- **Recoding** (Education) — Timed coding assessments with real code execution and anti-cheat monitoring. — layrus.com/projects/recoding
- **Certificate Verification** (Blockchain & Credentials) — Tamper-proof academic certificates that any employer can verify in seconds, without the university. — layrus.com/projects/certificate-verification
